claims: The RBC Heritage features a sudden-death playoff if players are tied after 72 holes of stroke play.
The RBC Heritage playoff begins immediately on the par-4 18th hole at Harbour Town Golf Links.
The RBC Heritage playoff alternates with the par-3 17th hole if necessary until a winner is determined by the lowest score.
The RBC Heritage playoff format is sudden-death.
In the RBC Heritage playoff, the first player to win a hole wins the tournament.
The RBC Heritage playoff starts on the 18th hole and moves to the 17th hole if necessary, repeating this rotation until a winner emerges.
The 2023 RBC Heritage event went to a playoff.
The 2025 RBC Heritage event went to a playoff.
Matt Fitzpatrick won the 2023 RBC Heritage in extra holes.
Matt Fitzpatrick won the 2026 RBC Heritage in extra holes.
Jordan Spieth won the 2022 RBC Heritage in extra holes.
The RBC Heritage is a PGA Tour Signature Event.
The RBC Heritage has a 70-plus player field.
The RBC Heritage 70-plus player field plays for 700 FedEx Cup points.
No cut is made after 36 holes in the RBC Heritage.
